name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Infrared saunas provide an effective way to relieve stress, fight depression, relax, remove toxins and heavy metals from the body, lose weight and improve circulation, gaining so much from just a simple Infrared Sauna session at home. Aqualine saunas offer high quality customer service and top grade products to assist people in their pursuit for well-being and lead a healthy way of life.



Aqualine experts and support team helps every client to find the best models to suit any requirement and budget without losing the quality of the service and the product itself. Affordable and practical Indoor Infrared Saunas are now available to anyone who wishes to gain the benefits of Infrared therapy at home without the need to waste time on visits to spa salons, public saunas and fitness clubs.



Every Infrared sauna unit will serve flawlessly for many years – this is achieved by a careful process of expert inspection and testing before shipment. Aqualine saunas are trustworthy and sturdy, non-toxic and non-allergenic, comfortable, safe and easy to install and use – all this will allow you to enjoy the best Infrared Therapy possible.
